source.text: שִׁמְעוּ־זֹ֣את בֵּֽית־יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַנִּקְרָאִים֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִמֵּ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יָצָ֑אוּ הַֽנִּשְׁבָּעִ֣ים׀בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֗ה וּבֵאלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יַזְכִּ֔ירוּ לֹ֥א בֶאֱמֶ֖ת וְלֹ֥א בִצְדָקָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear this, O house of Jacob, the [ones] called by [the] name of Israel, and from [the] waters of Judah they came out, the [ones] swearing by [the] name of Yahweh, and [of the] God of Israel they make mention, not in truth and not in righteousness.

en.L: Hear this, house of Jacob, [you who are] called by the name of Israel \q and [who] came out from the waters of Judah, \q [who] swear by the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and invoke the God of Israel, \q not in truth and not in righteousness.
en.B: Hear this, house of Jacob, you who bear the name Israel \q and sprang from the waters of Judah, \q you who swear by the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and call on the God of Israel, \q yet without truth and without righteousness.
en.R: Listen to this, people of Israel, descendants of Jacob and of Judah. \q You make promises in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and you pray to the God of Israel. \q But you are not honest, and you do not do what is right.

es.L: {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} esto, casa de Jacob, [los que] son llamados con el nombre de Israel \q y [que] salieron de las aguas de Judá, \q [los que] juran por el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} e invocan al Dios de Israel, \q no en verdad ni en justicia.
es.B: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} esto, casa de Jacob, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que llevan el nombre de Israel \q y brotaron de las aguas de Judá, \q que juran por el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} e invocan al Dios de Israel, \q pero sin verdad y sin justicia.
es.R: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} esto, pueblo de Israel, descendientes de Jacob y de Judá. \q {{plural_you:Ustedes hacen promesas|Vosotros hacéis promesas}} en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y {{plural_you:oran|oráis}} al Dios de Israel. \q Pero no {{plural_you:son sinceros, y no hacen|sois sinceros, y no hacéis}} lo que es justo.

fr.L: Écoutez ceci, maison de Jacob, [vous qui êtes] appelés du nom d’Israël \q et [qui] êtes sortis des eaux de Juda, \q [qui] jurez par le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et invoquez le Dieu d’Israël, \q non en vérité et non en justice.
fr.B: Écoutez ceci, maison de Jacob, vous qui portez le nom d’Israël \q et qui êtes issus des eaux de Juda, \q vous qui jurez par le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et invoquez le Dieu d’Israël, \q mais sans vérité et sans justice.
fr.R: Écoutez ceci, peuple d’Israël, descendants de Jacob et de Juda. \q Vous faites des promesses au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et vous priez le Dieu d’Israël. \q Mais vous n’êtes pas sincères, et vous ne faites pas ce qui est juste.

sw.L: Sikieni hili, nyumba ya Yakobo, [ninyi] mnaoitwa kwa jina la Israeli \q na [ambao] mlitoka katika maji ya Yuda, \q [ambao] mnaapa kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumtaja Mungu wa Israeli, \q si katika kweli wala si katika haki.
sw.B: Sikieni hili, nyumba ya Yakobo, ninyi mnaolibeba jina Israeli \q na mliochipuka kutoka katika maji ya Yuda, \q ninyi mnaoapa kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumwita Mungu wa Israeli, \q lakini bila kweli na bila haki.
sw.R: Sikilizeni jambo hili, enyi watu wa Israeli, wazao wa Yakobo na wa Yuda. \q Mnaweka ahadi kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na mnamwomba Mungu wa Israeli. \q Lakini ninyi si waaminifu, wala hamtendi yaliyo haki.

vi.L: Hãy nghe điều này, hỡi nhà Gia-cốp, [các ngươi là những kẻ] được gọi bằng danh Y-sơ-ra-ên \q và [là những kẻ] đã ra từ dòng nước của Giu-đa, \q [những kẻ] chỉ danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà thề và kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q nhưng không trong chân thật và không trong công chính.
vi.B: Hãy nghe điều này, hỡi nhà Gia-cốp, các ngươi là những kẻ mang danh Y-sơ-ra-ên \q và đã ra từ nguồn nước Giu-đa, \q các ngươi là những kẻ chỉ danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà thề và kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q nhưng chẳng có chân thật, chẳng có công chính.
vi.R: Hãy nghe điều này, hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, con cháu của Gia-cốp và của Giu-đa. \q Các ngươi nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà hứa nguyện, và các ngươi cầu nguyện với Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên. \q Nhưng các ngươi không thành thật, và các ngươi không làm điều công chính.

decisions.choice: came out from the waters of Judah: descended from Judah, as a stream flows from its spring
alternatives: came from the line of Judah
decisions.reason: Ancestry is pictured as water flowing from a source (Deuteronomy 33:28; Psalm 68:27). The people addressed are the descendants of Judah, the tribe at the heart of the nation that went into exile.

decisions.choice: invoke: name God in worship and prayer, call on him as one's own God
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring to mind or mention, and with God as object it is used of calling on him in worship (26:13; Exodus 23:13; Psalm 20:8).

decisions.choice: not in truth and not in righteousness: their worship is outward only
decisions.reason: They use God's name in oaths and prayers, but their lives do not match their words (29:13; 58:2; Jeremiah 5:2). Verse 2 shows the same empty claim.

decisions.choice: people of Israel, descendants of Jacob and of Judah
decisions.reason: Readable explains "house of Jacob", "called by the name of Israel" and "the waters of Judah" as plain statements of who the people are and where they came from.

decisions.choice: make promises in the name of the LORD; you are not honest, and you do not do what is right
decisions.reason: Readable says what swearing by God's name is (making a promise with God as witness) and spells out "not in truth and not in righteousness". Righteousness here is right living, so Readable says "do what is right".

source.text: כִּֽי־מֵעִ֤יר הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ נִקְרָ֔אוּ וְעַל־אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נִסְמָ֑כוּ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For from [the] city of the holiness they have called themselves, and on [the] God of Israel they have supported themselves; Yahweh of hosts [is] his name.

en.L: For they call themselves after the holy city, \q and on the God of Israel they lean; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.B: For they name themselves after the holy city \q and lean for support on the God of Israel; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.R: They say they belong to the holy city of Jerusalem, \q and they say they depend on the God of Israel. \q His name is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

es.L: Porque se llaman [según] la ciudad santa, \q y en el Dios de Israel se apoyan; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.B: Porque toman su nombre de la ciudad santa \q y se apoyan en el Dios de Israel; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.R: Dicen que pertenecen a la ciudad santa de Jerusalén, \q y dicen que dependen del Dios de Israel. \q Su nombre es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

fr.L: Car ils se nomment d’après la ville sainte, \q et sur le Dieu d’Israël ils s’appuient ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.B: Car ils tirent leur nom de la ville sainte \q et prennent appui sur le Dieu d’Israël ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, voilà {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.R: Ils disent qu’ils appartiennent à la ville sainte de Jérusalem, \q et ils disent qu’ils comptent sur le Dieu d’Israël. \q Son nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

sw.L: Kwa maana wanajiita kwa jina la mji mtakatifu, \q na juu ya Mungu wa Israeli wanaegemea; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi [ndilo] jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana wanajiita kwa jina la mji mtakatifu \q na kumtegemea Mungu wa Israeli; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.R: Wanasema kwamba wao ni wa mji mtakatifu wa Yerusalemu, \q na wanasema kwamba wanamtegemea Mungu wa Israeli. \q Jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

vi.L: Vì chúng tự xưng theo thành thánh, \q và nương cậy nơi Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân [là] danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì chúng lấy tên thành thánh mà tự xưng \q và tựa vào Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân là danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Họ nói rằng họ thuộc về thành thánh Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q và họ nói rằng họ nương cậy nơi Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên. \q Danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân.

decisions.choice: the holy city: Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Jerusalem is called the holy city in 52:1 and Nehemiah 11:1. The people take pride in belonging to it, the city where God's house stood.

decisions.choice: for: their claims explain why they use God's name, but the claims are empty
decisions.reason: The verse gives the ground of verse 1: they call on the God of Israel because they belong to his city and rely on him. After verse 1 ends "not in truth", the claim of relying on him rings hollow.

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts: the LORD who commands the armies of heaven
decisions.reason: See the note at 1:9.

decisions.choice: the holy city of Jerusalem; they say they depend on
decisions.reason: Readable names the city and repeats "they say", since what follows verse 1 shows the claim is not matched by their lives.

source.text: הָרִֽאשֹׁנוֹת֙ מֵאָ֣ז הִגַּ֔דְתִּי וּמִפִּ֥י יָצְא֖וּ וְאַשְׁמִיעֵ֑ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם עָשִׂ֖יתִי וַתָּבֹֽאנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: The former [things] from then I declared, and from my mouth they went out, and I made them heard; suddenly I acted, and they came.

en.L: The former [things] I declared from long ago, \q and from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} mouth they went out, and I made them heard; \q suddenly I acted, and they came [to pass].
en.B: What came first I foretold long before; \q it issued from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} mouth, and I let it be heard. \q Then all at once I acted, and it took place.
en.R: Long ago I told you what would happen. \q I said it out loud and let people hear it. \q Then suddenly I made it happen, and it all came true.

es.L: Las cosas primeras desde antiguo [las] anuncié, \q y de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} boca salieron, y las hice oír; \q de repente obré, y vinieron.
es.B: Lo primero lo anuncié mucho antes; \q salió de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} boca, y lo hice oír. \q Luego, de golpe, actué, y sucedió.
es.R: Hace mucho tiempo te dije lo que iba a pasar. \q Lo dije en voz alta y dejé que la gente lo oyera. \q Luego, de repente, hice que sucediera, y todo se cumplió.

fr.L: Les choses d’autrefois, je les ai annoncées dès longtemps, \q et de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} bouche elles sont sorties, et je les ai fait entendre ; \q soudain j’ai agi, et elles sont arrivées.
fr.B: Ce qui est arrivé d’abord, je l’avais prédit longtemps à l’avance ; \q cela est sorti de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} bouche, et je l’ai fait entendre. \q Puis, tout à coup, j’ai agi, et cela s’est produit.
fr.R: Il y a longtemps, je vous ai dit ce qui allait arriver. \q Je l’ai dit à haute voix et je l’ai fait entendre. \q Puis, tout à coup, je l’ai fait arriver, et tout s’est réalisé.

sw.L: Mambo ya kwanza niliyatangaza tangu zamani, \q na kutoka kinywani {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}} yalitoka, nami nikayasikizisha; \q ghafula nilitenda, nayo yakatokea.
sw.B: Mambo ya kwanza niliyatabiri zamani sana; \q yalitoka kinywani {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}}, nami nikayafanya yasikike. \q Kisha ghafula nilitenda, nayo yakatokea.
sw.R: Zamani sana niliwaambia yatakayotokea. \q Niliyasema kwa sauti na kuwaacha watu wayasikie. \q Kisha ghafula niliyafanya yatokee, nayo yote yakatimia.

vi.L: Những [việc] trước kia {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã báo từ lâu, \q và chúng đã ra từ miệng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cho người ta nghe; \q thình lình {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hành động, và chúng đã đến.
vi.B: Những việc ban đầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã báo trước từ lâu; \q chúng ra từ miệng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cho người ta nghe. \q Rồi bỗng chốc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hành động, và chúng đã xảy ra.
vi.R: Từ lâu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nói cho các ngươi biết điều sẽ xảy ra. \q Ta đã nói ra và cho người ta nghe. \q Rồi bỗng nhiên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm cho điều đó xảy ra, và mọi sự đều thành sự thật.

decisions.choice: the former things: earlier events that God announced beforehand and then brought about
decisions.reason: Chapters 41-48 return again and again to things God foretold and then did, as proof that he alone is God (41:22; 42:9; 43:9, 18; 46:9-10).

decisions.choice: suddenly I acted: the fulfilment came without warning, by God's own act
decisions.reason: The word was spoken long before; the deed came suddenly. No one could credit any other power with it, since God had named it in advance.

source.text: מִדַּעְתִּ֕י כִּ֥י קָשֶׁ֖ה אָ֑תָּה וְגִ֤יד בַּרְזֶל֙ עָרְפֶּ֔ךָ וּמִצְחֲךָ֖ נְחוּשָֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: Because I knew that stubborn [are] you, and a sinew of iron [is] your neck, and your forehead [is] bronze,

en.L: Because I knew that you [are] stubborn, \q and your neck [is] an iron sinew, and your forehead bronze,
en.B: Because I knew how unyielding you are, \q your neck a cord of iron and your forehead bronze,
en.R: I knew how stubborn you are. \q Your neck is as stiff as iron, and your forehead is as hard as bronze.

es.L: Porque yo sabía que tú [eres] obstinado, \q y tu cerviz [es] un tendón de hierro, y tu frente de bronce,
es.B: Porque yo sabía lo terco que eres, \q que tu cuello es un tendón de hierro y tu frente de bronce,
es.R: Yo sabía lo terco que eres. \q Tu cuello es tan rígido como el hierro, y tu frente es tan dura como el bronce.

fr.L: Parce que je savais que tu [es] obstiné, \q et ta nuque [est] un tendon de fer, et ton front de bronze,
fr.B: Parce que je savais combien tu es inflexible, \q ta nuque comme un câble de fer et ton front de bronze,
fr.R: Je savais combien tu es têtu. \q Ta nuque est aussi raide que le fer, et ton front aussi dur que le bronze.

sw.L: Kwa sababu nilijua kwamba wewe [ni] mkaidi, \q na shingo yako [ni] mshipa wa chuma, na kipaji chako shaba,
sw.B: Kwa sababu nilijua jinsi ulivyo mkaidi, \q shingo yako ni kano la chuma na kipaji chako cha uso ni shaba,
sw.R: Nilijua jinsi ulivyo mkaidi. \q Shingo yako ni ngumu kama chuma, na kipaji chako cha uso ni kigumu kama shaba.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} biết rằng ngươi [là] cứng đầu, \q và cổ ngươi [là] gân sắt, và trán ngươi [là] đồng,
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} biết ngươi cứng cỏi đến thế nào, \q cổ ngươi như sợi gân sắt, trán ngươi như đồng,
vi.R: Ta biết ngươi cứng đầu biết bao. \q Cổ ngươi cứng như sắt, và trán ngươi rắn như đồng.

decisions.choice: your neck an iron sinew: you refuse to bow or be led
decisions.reason: A stiff neck is an animal that will not turn under the yoke; Israel is called "stiff-necked" from the wilderness on (Exodus 32:9; Deuteronomy 31:27).

decisions.choice: your forehead bronze: shameless, unmoved by rebuke
decisions.reason: A hard forehead is a face that does not blush or yield (Jeremiah 3:3; Ezekiel 3:7-9).

decisions.choice: because I knew: the reason for what verse 5 says God did
decisions.reason: The sentence runs on into verse 5: God announced events long before because he knew how stubborn his people were.

decisions.choice: rebellious Israel addressed as "ngươi" at every level
decisions.reason: In this rebuke God speaks to the stubborn people as one person; Balanced and Readable keep the cooler "ngươi" here rather than the "con" of the promises, as Literal does throughout.

source.text: וָאַגִּ֤יד לְךָ֙ מֵאָ֔ז בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֑יךָ פֶּן־תֹּאמַר֙ עָצְבִּ֣י עָשָׂ֔ם וּפִסְלִ֥י וְנִסְכִּ֖י צִוָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and I declared [them] to you from then; before it came I made you hear, lest you should say, my idol did them, and my carved image and my molten image commanded them.

en.L: and I declared [them] to you from long ago; \q before [they] came I made you hear [them], \q lest you should say, "My idol did them, \q and my carved image and my cast image commanded them."
en.B: so I announced them to you in advance; \q I let you hear of them before they came, \q so that you could never say, "My idol made them happen; \q my carved image and my molten god decreed them."
en.R: So I told you about these things long before they happened. \q Then you could not say, "My idol did this. \q My carved statue and my metal statue made it happen."

es.L: y te [las] anuncié desde antiguo; \q antes que vinieran te [las] hice oír, \q no fuera que dijeras: «Mi ídolo las hizo, \q y mi imagen tallada y mi imagen fundida las ordenaron».
es.B: por eso te las anuncié de antemano; \q te las di a conocer antes de que llegaran, \q para que nunca pudieras decir: «Mi ídolo las hizo suceder; \q mi imagen tallada y mi dios de metal fundido las decretaron».
es.R: Por eso te conté estas cosas mucho antes de que sucedieran. \q Así no podrías decir: «Mi ídolo hizo esto. \q Mi estatua tallada y mi estatua de metal lo hicieron suceder».

fr.L: je te [les] ai annoncées dès longtemps ; \q avant qu’[elles] arrivent, je te [les] ai fait entendre, \q de peur que tu ne dises : « Mon idole les a faites, \q et mon image sculptée et mon image de métal fondu les ont ordonnées. »
fr.B: je te les ai donc annoncées à l’avance ; \q je te les ai fait connaître avant qu’elles arrivent, \q pour que tu ne puisses jamais dire : « C’est mon idole qui les a fait arriver ; \q ma statue sculptée, mon dieu de métal les a décrétées. »
fr.R: Alors je t’ai parlé de ces choses longtemps avant qu’elles arrivent. \q Ainsi, tu ne pouvais pas dire : « C’est mon idole qui a fait cela. \q Ma statue sculptée et ma statue de métal l’ont fait arriver. »

sw.L: nami nilikutangazia tangu zamani; \q kabla [hayajatokea] nilikusikizisha, \q usije ukasema, "Sanamu yangu iliyafanya, \q na sanamu yangu ya kuchonga na sanamu yangu ya kuyeyushwa iliyaamuru."
sw.B: kwa hiyo nilikutangazia mapema; \q nilikujulisha kabla hayajatokea, \q ili usije ukasema kamwe, "Sanamu yangu ndiyo iliyoyafanya yatokee; \q sanamu yangu ya kuchonga na mungu wangu wa kuyeyushwa ndio walioyaamuru."
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nilikuambia mambo haya muda mrefu kabla hayajatokea. \q Ndipo usingeweza kusema, "Sanamu yangu imefanya hivi. \q Sanamu yangu ya kuchonga na sanamu yangu ya chuma ndizo zilizoyafanya yatokee."

vi.L: nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã báo [chúng] cho ngươi từ lâu; \q trước khi [chúng] đến, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cho ngươi nghe [chúng], \q kẻo ngươi nói: "Thần tượng của tôi đã làm những việc ấy, \q và tượng chạm của tôi và tượng đúc của tôi đã truyền lệnh cho chúng."
vi.B: nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã báo trước cho ngươi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cho ngươi nghe trước khi chúng đến, \q để ngươi không thể nói: "Thần tượng của tôi đã làm cho chúng xảy ra; \q tượng chạm và thần đúc của tôi đã truyền lệnh."
vi.R: Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nói cho ngươi biết những việc ấy từ lâu trước khi chúng xảy ra. \q Như vậy ngươi không thể nói: "Thần tượng của tôi đã làm việc này. \q Tượng chạm và tượng kim loại của tôi đã làm cho nó xảy ra."

decisions.choice: lest you should say: prophecy was given so that idols could get no credit
decisions.reason: God told events in advance so that Israel could not credit its idols with them. The chapters around this one make the same claim against the gods of the nations (41:21-29; 44:7-8).

decisions.choice: carved image and cast image: idols carved from wood or stone, and idols made of poured metal
decisions.reason: The two words name the two usual kinds of idol (40:19-20; 44:9-17). The first is shaped with tools; the second is cast in a mold.

source.text: שָׁמַ֤עְתָּֽ חֲזֵה֙ כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְאַתֶּ֖ם הֲל֣וֹא תַגִּ֑ידוּ הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֤יךָ חֲדָשׁוֹת֙ מֵעַ֔תָּה וּנְצֻר֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: You have heard; look at all of it; and you, will you not declare? I make you hear new [things] from now, and guarded [things], and you have not known them.

en.L: You have heard; look at all of it! \q And you, will you not declare [it]? \q I make you hear new [things] from now on, \q and hidden [things], and you have not known them.
en.B: You heard it; now see the whole of it. \q Will you yourselves not testify to it? \q From now on I make new things known to you, \q things kept hidden that you never knew.
en.R: You heard what I said, and now you can see it all happen. \q So will you not tell others about it? \q From now on I will tell you about new things. \q They are secrets you have never known.

es.L: Lo has oído; ¡mira todo esto! \q ¿Y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no [lo] {{plural_you:anunciarán|anunciaréis}}? \q Te hago oír cosas nuevas desde ahora, \q y cosas guardadas, que no conocías.
es.B: Lo oíste; ahora mira todo esto. \q ¿No {{plural_you:darán testimonio ustedes mismos|daréis testimonio vosotros mismos}}? \q Desde ahora te doy a conocer cosas nuevas, \q cosas escondidas que nunca supiste.
es.R: Oíste lo que dije, y ahora puedes verlo todo suceder. \q ¿No se lo {{plural_you:contarán|contaréis}} a otros? \q Desde ahora te hablaré de cosas nuevas. \q Son secretos que nunca has conocido.

fr.L: Tu as entendu ; regarde tout cela ! \q Et vous, ne [l’]annoncerez-vous pas ? \q Je te fais entendre des choses nouvelles dès maintenant, \q et des choses cachées, et tu ne les as pas connues.
fr.B: Tu l’as entendu ; maintenant, vois-le tout entier. \q Et vous, n’en rendrez-vous pas témoignage ? \q Désormais je te fais connaître des choses nouvelles, \q des choses gardées secrètes que tu n’as jamais connues.
fr.R: Tu as entendu ce que j’ai dit, et maintenant tu peux voir tout cela arriver. \q Alors, ne le direz-vous pas aux autres ? \q À partir de maintenant, je vais te parler de choses nouvelles. \q Ce sont des secrets que tu n’as jamais connus.

sw.L: Umesikia; tazama yote haya! \q Nanyi, je, hamtayatangaza? \q Ninakusikizisha mambo mapya tangu sasa, \q na mambo yaliyofichwa, nawe hukuyajua.
sw.B: Uliyasikia; sasa yaone yote. \q Je, ninyi wenyewe hamtayashuhudia? \q Tangu sasa ninakujulisha mambo mapya, \q mambo yaliyofichwa ambayo hukuwahi kuyajua.
sw.R: Ulisikia nilichosema, na sasa unaweza kuona yote yakitokea. \q Je, hutawaambia wengine habari zake? \q Tangu sasa nitakuambia mambo mapya. \q Ni siri ambazo hukuwahi kuzijua.

vi.L: Ngươi đã nghe; hãy xem tất cả điều đó! \q Còn các ngươi, các ngươi há chẳng báo [ra] sao? \q Ta cho ngươi nghe những [việc] mới từ nay, \q và những [việc] giấu kín mà ngươi chưa biết.
vi.B: Ngươi đã nghe rồi; bây giờ hãy xem trọn mọi điều ấy. \q Chính các ngươi lại không làm chứng về điều đó sao? \q Từ nay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho ngươi biết những việc mới, \q những việc được giấu kín mà ngươi chưa hề biết.
vi.R: Ngươi đã nghe điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói, và bây giờ ngươi có thể thấy tất cả xảy ra. \q Vậy các ngươi không nói cho người khác biết sao? \q Từ nay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nói cho ngươi biết những việc mới. \q Đó là những điều bí mật ngươi chưa bao giờ biết.

decisions.choice: will you not declare it: a question that expects yes; Israel must bear witness
decisions.reason: Israel has heard the predictions and seen them come true, so it should testify to what God has done (43:10, 12; 44:8).

decisions.choice: new things, hidden things: coming events God now reveals, kept until now
decisions.reason: The new things are the events of the following verses: the one God has called acting against Babylon and the people leaving it (verses 14-15, 20; 42:9; 43:19). "Hidden" means guarded or kept in reserve.

source.text: עַתָּ֤ה נִבְרְאוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א מֵאָ֔ז וְלִפְנֵי־י֖וֹם וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתָּ֑ם פֶּן־תֹּאמַ֖ר הִנֵּ֥ה יְדַעְתִּֽין׃

records.literal_gloss: Now they have been created, and not from then, and before a day, and you had not heard them, lest you should say, here! I knew them.

en.L: Now they have been created, and not from long ago, \q and before today you had not heard of them, \q lest you should say, "Look, I knew them."
en.B: Only now are they brought into being, not in days gone by; \q until today you never heard of them. \q So you cannot claim, "See, I knew that all along."
en.R: I am making them happen now. They did not happen long ago. \q You had never heard about them before today. \q So you cannot say, "I already knew about that."

es.L: Ahora han sido creadas, y no desde antiguo, \q y antes de hoy no las habías oído, \q no fuera que dijeras: «Mira, yo las sabía».
es.B: Solo ahora son traídas a la existencia, no en días pasados; \q hasta hoy nunca habías oído de ellas. \q Así no puedes decir: «Mira, eso ya lo sabía yo».
es.R: Las estoy haciendo suceder ahora. No sucedieron hace mucho. \q Nunca habías oído hablar de ellas antes de hoy. \q Así no puedes decir: «Eso ya lo sabía».

fr.L: Maintenant elles ont été créées, et non dès longtemps, \q et avant aujourd’hui tu n’en avais pas entendu parler, \q de peur que tu ne dises : « Voici, je les connaissais. »
fr.B: C’est maintenant seulement qu’elles sont créées, et non aux jours d’autrefois ; \q jusqu’à aujourd’hui tu n’en avais jamais entendu parler. \q Ainsi, tu ne pourras pas prétendre : « Je le savais depuis toujours. »
fr.R: Je les fais arriver maintenant. Elles ne sont pas arrivées il y a longtemps. \q Avant aujourd’hui, tu n’en avais jamais entendu parler. \q Alors tu ne peux pas dire : « Je le savais déjà. »

sw.L: Sasa yameumbwa, wala si tangu zamani, \q na kabla ya leo hukuwa umeyasikia, \q usije ukasema, "Tazama, niliyajua."
sw.B: Ni sasa tu yanaletwa yawepo, si katika siku zilizopita; \q mpaka leo hukuwahi kuyasikia. \q Kwa hiyo huwezi kudai, "Tazama, nilijua hilo tangu zamani."
sw.R: Ninayafanya yatokee sasa. Hayakutokea zamani. \q Hukuwahi kuyasikia kabla ya leo. \q Kwa hiyo huwezi kusema, "Nilikuwa nimeshajua hilo."

vi.L: Bây giờ chúng mới được sáng tạo, chứ không phải từ lâu, \q và trước hôm nay ngươi chưa nghe về chúng, \q kẻo ngươi nói: "Kìa, tôi đã biết chúng rồi."
vi.B: Bây giờ chúng mới được tạo nên, chứ không phải từ những ngày xa xưa; \q cho đến hôm nay ngươi chưa hề nghe về chúng. \q Vì vậy ngươi không thể nói: "Đấy, tôi đã biết điều đó từ lâu."
vi.R: Bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mới làm cho chúng xảy ra. Chúng không xảy ra từ lâu. \q Trước hôm nay ngươi chưa bao giờ nghe về chúng. \q Vì vậy ngươi không thể nói: "Tôi đã biết chuyện đó rồi."

decisions.choice: they have been created: God brings these events into being
decisions.reason: The verb for God's creating is used here of events in history, as in 41:20 and 45:7-8: what happens is as much his work as the world itself.

decisions.choice: before a day: before today
decisions.reason: The short phrase most likely means "before this day". It could also mean "before the day they happen", with little change to the sense.

source.text: גַּ֣ם לֹֽא־שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ גַּ֚ם לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתָּ גַּ֕ם מֵאָ֖ז לֹא־פִתְּחָ֣ה אָזְנֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י יָדַ֨עְתִּי֙ בָּג֣וֹד תִּבְגּ֔וֹד וּפֹשֵׁ֥עַ מִבֶּ֖טֶן קֹ֥רָא לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Neither have you heard, nor have you known, nor from then was it opened your ear, for I knew [that] surely you would act treacherously, and a rebel from [the] womb it has been called to you.

en.L: Neither have you heard, nor have you known, \q nor from long ago was your ear opened; \q for I knew [that] you would surely act treacherously, \q and "Rebel from [the] womb" you were called.
en.B: You have not heard and have not known; \q long ago your ear stayed shut. \q For I knew that you would surely prove faithless, \q and you were named "Rebel from the womb."
en.R: You had not heard about these things or known about them. \q Long ago your ears were closed to them. \q I knew you would be unfaithful. Even from birth you were called a rebel.

es.L: Ni lo has oído, ni lo has sabido, \q ni desde antiguo se abrió tu oído; \q porque yo sabía [que] ciertamente obrarías con traición, \q y «Rebelde desde el vientre» te llamaron.
es.B: No lo has oído ni lo has sabido; \q desde hace mucho tu oído ha estado cerrado. \q Porque yo sabía que sin duda serías infiel, \q y te llamaron «Rebelde desde el vientre».
es.R: No habías oído estas cosas ni las conocías. \q Hace mucho tiempo tus oídos estaban cerrados a ellas. \q Yo sabía que serías infiel. Desde que naciste te llamaron rebelde.

fr.L: Tu n’as pas entendu, et tu n’as pas su, \q et depuis longtemps ton oreille n’a pas été ouverte ; \q car je savais que tu agirais vraiment en traître, \q et « Rebelle dès le sein » on t’a appelé.
fr.B: Tu n’as rien entendu et tu n’as rien su ; \q depuis longtemps ton oreille est restée fermée. \q Car je savais que tu serais certainement infidèle, \q et on t’a nommé « Rebelle dès le sein maternel ».
fr.R: Tu n’avais pas entendu parler de ces choses, tu ne les connaissais pas. \q Depuis longtemps, tes oreilles leur étaient fermées. \q Je savais que tu serais infidèle. Dès ta naissance, on t’a appelé rebelle.

sw.L: Hukusikia, wala hukujua, \q wala tangu zamani sikio lako halikufunguliwa; \q kwa maana nilijua kwamba hakika utatenda kwa hila, \q nawe uliitwa "Mwasi tangu tumboni."
sw.B: Hukusikia wala hukujua; \q tangu zamani sikio lako lilibaki limefungwa. \q Kwa maana nilijua kwamba hakika ungekuwa mwenye hila, \q nawe ukaitwa "Mwasi tangu tumboni."
sw.R: Hukuwa umesikia mambo haya wala kuyajua. \q Zamani masikio yako yalikuwa yamefungwa yasiyasikie. \q Nilijua utakuwa si mwaminifu. Hata tangu kuzaliwa uliitwa mwasi.

vi.L: Ngươi đã chẳng nghe, ngươi cũng chẳng biết, \q từ lâu tai ngươi cũng chẳng được mở ra; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} biết [rằng] ngươi chắc chắn sẽ hành động phản trắc, \q và ngươi đã bị gọi là "Kẻ phản nghịch từ trong lòng mẹ".
vi.B: Ngươi đã không nghe, cũng không biết; \q từ lâu tai ngươi đã đóng kín. \q Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} biết ngươi chắc chắn sẽ bội tín, \q và ngươi đã mang tên "Kẻ phản nghịch từ lúc lọt lòng".
vi.R: Ngươi chưa nghe về những điều này và cũng chưa biết về chúng. \q Từ lâu tai ngươi đã đóng lại với chúng. \q Ta biết ngươi sẽ bất trung. Ngay từ lúc mới sinh, ngươi đã bị gọi là kẻ phản nghịch.

decisions.choice: your ear was not opened: you did not listen, and so these things were not made known to you
alternatives: I had not opened your ear to them
decisions.reason: The verb can be read of Israel's closed ear (they would not hear) or of God not opening it (he had not yet told them). The second half of the verse, about Israel's faithlessness, favors the first; verse 7 fits the second.

decisions.choice: rebel from the womb: unfaithful from the nation's very beginning
decisions.reason: Israel's rebellion goes back to its birth as a people, in Egypt and the wilderness (Deuteronomy 9:7, 24; Ezekiel 20:5-8; Hosea 12:3).

decisions.choice: you would surely act treacherously: the doubled verb stresses certainty
decisions.reason: The verb is repeated for emphasis. The same root is used of betrayal in 21:2 and 33:1.

source.text: לְמַ֤עַן שְׁמִי֙ אַאֲרִ֣יךְ אַפִּ֔י וּתְהִלָּתִ֖י אֶחֱטָם־לָ֑ךְ לְבִלְתִּ֖י הַכְרִיתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: For the sake of my name I make long my anger, and [for] my praise I restrain myself for you, to not cut you off.

en.L: For the sake of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name I make {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger long, \q and [for] {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} praise I restrain [it] for you, \q so as not to cut you off.
en.B: To honor {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name I am slow to let {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger loose; \q for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} praise I rein it in for your good, \q so that I will not cut you off.
en.R: I am patient and hold back {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger because of who I am. \q I want to be praised, so I keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger back. \q I will not destroy you.

es.L: Por amor de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre retardo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira, \q y [por] {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alabanza la contengo para contigo, \q para no cortarte.
es.B: Para honrar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre tardo en soltar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira; \q por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alabanza la refreno para tu bien, \q para no destruirte.
es.R: Soy paciente y contengo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo por ser quien soy. \q Quiero ser alabado, por eso retengo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo. \q No te destruiré.

fr.L: À cause de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom je retarde {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, \q et [pour] {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} louange je [la] retiens pour toi, \q afin de ne pas te retrancher.
fr.B: Pour l’honneur de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, je suis lent à laisser éclater {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère ; \q pour {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} louange, je la retiens pour ton bien, \q afin de ne pas te retrancher.
fr.R: Je suis patient et je retiens {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère à cause de qui je suis. \q Je veux qu’on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} loue, alors je garde {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Je ne te détruirai pas.

sw.L: Kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} ninairefusha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, \q na [kwa ajili ya] sifa {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} ninaizuia kwa ajili yako, \q nisije nikakukatilia mbali.
sw.B: Ili kuliheshimu jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, sitaiachilia hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} upesi; \q kwa ajili ya sifa {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} ninaizuia kwa faida yako, \q ili nisikukatilie mbali.
sw.R: Mimi ni mvumilivu na ninaizuia hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kwa sababu ya jinsi {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nilivyo. \q Nataka nisifiwe, kwa hiyo ninaizuia hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Sitakuangamiza.

vi.L: Vì cớ danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dằn cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lại lâu, \q và [vì] lời ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} kiềm chế [nó] vì ngươi, \q để không diệt trừ ngươi.
vi.B: Vì danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chậm buông cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q vì lời ca ngợi dành cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} kìm nó lại vì ích lợi của ngươi, \q để {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không diệt trừ ngươi.
vi.R: Ta kiên nhẫn và giữ cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lại vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Đấng như thế. \q Ta muốn được ca ngợi, nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} kìm cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lại. \q Ta sẽ không tiêu diệt ngươi.

decisions.choice: I make my anger long: I am slow to anger, patient
decisions.reason: The phrase recalls God's description of himself as "slow to anger" (Exodus 34:6; Numbers 14:18).

decisions.choice: for my name, for my praise: God spares Israel for the sake of his own honor
decisions.reason: The ground of mercy is not Israel's goodness (verse 8) but God's name and praise among the nations (verse 11; Ezekiel 20:9, 14; 36:22).

decisions.choice: because of who I am; I want to be praised
decisions.reason: Readable explains "for the sake of my name" (God's name stands for who he is and his reputation) and "for my praise".

source.text: הִנֵּ֥ה צְרַפְתִּ֖יךָ וְלֹ֣א בְכָ֑סֶף בְּחַרְתִּ֖יךָ בְּכ֥וּר עֹֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, I have refined you, and not with silver; I have chosen you in a furnace of affliction.

en.L: Look, I have refined you, and not as silver; \q I have chosen you in a furnace of affliction.
en.B: See, I have put you through the refiner's fire, but not as silver; \q I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.
en.R: I have purified you as a metalworker purifies metal in a fire, but not the way silver is purified. \q I chose you while you were suffering, as if in a hot furnace.

es.L: Mira, te he refinado, pero no como a la plata; \q te he escogido en el horno de la aflicción.
es.B: Mira, te he hecho pasar por el fuego del refinador, pero no como a la plata; \q te he escogido en el horno de la aflicción.
es.R: Te he purificado como el que trabaja los metales purifica el metal en el fuego, pero no de la manera en que se purifica la plata. \q Te escogí cuando estabas sufriendo, como si estuvieras en un horno ardiente.

fr.L: Voici, je t’ai épuré, et non comme l’argent ; \q je t’ai choisi dans la fournaise de l’affliction.
fr.B: Vois, je t’ai fait passer au feu du fondeur, mais non comme l’argent ; \q je t’ai choisi dans la fournaise de l’affliction.
fr.R: Je t’ai purifié comme un fondeur purifie le métal dans le feu, mais pas comme on purifie l’argent. \q Je t’ai choisi pendant que tu souffrais, comme dans un four brûlant.

sw.L: Tazama, nimekusafisha, wala si kama fedha; \q nimekuchagua katika tanuru la mateso.
sw.B: Tazama, nimekupitisha katika moto wa msafishaji, lakini si kama fedha; \q nimekuchagua katika tanuru la mateso.
sw.R: Nimekusafisha kama fundi anavyosafisha madini katika moto, lakini si jinsi fedha inavyosafishwa. \q Nilikuchagua ulipokuwa ukiteseka, kana kwamba katika tanuru la moto.

vi.L: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã luyện ngươi, nhưng không như bạc; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn ngươi trong lò hoạn nạn.
vi.B: Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đưa ngươi qua lửa luyện, nhưng không như luyện bạc; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn ngươi trong lò hoạn nạn.
vi.R: Ta đã tinh luyện ngươi như người thợ luyện kim loại trong lửa, nhưng không theo cách người ta luyện bạc. \q Ta đã chọn ngươi khi ngươi đang chịu khổ, như thể ở trong một lò lửa nóng.

decisions.choice: I have chosen you
decisions.reason: The standard Hebrew text reads "I have chosen you". The picture of refining suggests a sense like "test" or "try", and the Great Isaiah Scroll (1QIsa-a) reads a verb meaning "I have tested you" (a reading cited here from memory; to be checked). Both fit: God chose Israel in its suffering, or he tested it there.

decisions.choice: not as silver: the refining was not like the refining of silver
decisions.reason: The phrase is short and its point is uncertain. It may mean God did not refine Israel as fully as silver is refined, or Israel would have been consumed; or that the refining brought no silver, since so little pure metal was found (1:22, 25; Jeremiah 6:29-30).

decisions.choice: the furnace of affliction: hard suffering that tests and purifies
decisions.reason: Egypt is called an "iron furnace" from which God brought his people (Deuteronomy 4:20; 1 Kings 8:51; Jeremiah 11:4). The exile is a new furnace.

decisions.choice: as a metalworker purifies metal in a fire; while you were suffering, as if in a hot furnace
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of refining and of the furnace.

source.text: לְמַעֲנִ֧י לְמַעֲנִ֛י אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה כִּ֣י אֵ֣יךְ יֵחָ֑ל וּכְבוֹדִ֖י לְאַחֵ֥ר לֹֽא־אֶתֵּֽן׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For my sake, for my sake I will act, for how will it be profaned? And my glory to another I will not give.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sake, for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sake I will act, for how would [it] be profaned? \q And {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory to another I will not give.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own sake, for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own sake I act, for why should {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name be dishonored? \q I will not give {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory to another.
en.R: I do this for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own sake, yes, for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own sake. I will not let people dishonor {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. \q I will not give {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory to anyone else.

es.L: Por amor de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, por amor de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} lo haré, pues ¿cómo sería profanado? \q Y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria a otro no daré.
es.B: Por amor a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} mismo, por amor a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} mismo actúo, pues ¿por qué habría de ser deshonrado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre? \q No daré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria a otro.
es.R: Hago esto por amor a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} mismo, sí, por amor a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} mismo. No dejaré que la gente deshonre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre. \q No daré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria a nadie más.

fr.L: À cause de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, à cause de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} j’agirai, car comment [cela] serait-il profané ? \q Et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire, je ne la donnerai pas à un autre.
fr.B: C’est pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, pour {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}} que j’agis, car pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom serait-il déshonoré ? \q Je ne donnerai pas {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire à un autre.
fr.R: Je fais cela pour {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}, oui, pour {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}. Je ne laisserai pas les gens déshonorer {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. \q Je ne donnerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire à personne d’autre.

sw.L: Kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} nitatenda, kwa maana [jina] lingetiwaje unajisi? \q Na utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} sitampa mwingine.
sw.B: Kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} mwenyewe, kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} mwenyewe ninatenda, kwa maana jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} litukanwe kwa nini? \q Sitampa mwingine utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.R: Ninafanya hivi kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} mwenyewe, naam, kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} mwenyewe. Sitawaacha watu walidharau jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. \q Sitampa mtu mwingine yeyote utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, vì chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hành động, vì làm sao [danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}] lại bị xúc phạm? \q Và vinh quang {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không ban cho kẻ khác.
vi.B: Vì chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, vì chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hành động, vì sao danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lại bị xúc phạm? \q Ta sẽ không nhường vinh quang {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho ai khác.
vi.R: Ta làm điều này vì chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, phải, vì chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta sẽ không để người ta xúc phạm danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Ta sẽ không ban vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho ai khác.

decisions.choice: how would it be profaned: the subject is God's name, understood from verse 9
decisions.reason: The verb has no stated subject. Verse 9 speaks of "my name", and the Septuagint supplies "my name" here (cited from memory; to be checked). If God let his people perish, his name would be dishonored among the nations (Ezekiel 20:9; 36:20-23).

decisions.choice: my glory I will not give to another: God will not share his honor with idols
decisions.reason: The same words are in 42:8, where "another" is set beside "carved images". Here the point is that idols will get no credit for Israel's release.

decisions.choice: my name
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the subject that the Hebrew leaves unstated; Literal keeps "[it]". Readable turns the question into a statement.

source.text: שְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַי֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְקֹרָאִ֑י אֲנִי־הוּא֙ אֲנִ֣י רִאשׁ֔וֹן אַ֖ף אֲנִ֥י אַחֲרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel my called [one]: I [am] he; I [am] first, also I [am] last.

en.L: Listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, Jacob, and Israel, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} called [one]: \q I [am] he; I [am the] first, also I [am the] last.
en.B: Hear {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, Jacob, Israel, the one I called: \q I am he. I am the first; I am the last as well.
en.R: Listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, people of Israel, descendants of Jacob, whom I have called. \q I am the one who is God. \q I was there at the beginning, and I will be there at the end.

es.L: Escúchame a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, Jacob, e Israel, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} llamado: \q Yo [soy] él; yo [soy el] primero, también yo [soy el] último.
es.B: Escúchame a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, Jacob, Israel, a quien yo llamé: \q Yo soy. Yo soy el primero; también soy el último.
es.R: Escúchame a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, pueblo de Israel, descendientes de Jacob, a quienes he llamado. \q Solo yo soy Dios. \q Yo estaba allí al principio, y estaré allí al final.

fr.L: Écoute-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, Jacob, et Israël, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} appelé : \q c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; je [suis le] premier, je [suis] aussi [le] dernier.
fr.B: Écoute-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, Jacob, Israël, toi que j’ai appelé : \q c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Je suis le premier, et je suis aussi le dernier.
fr.R: Écoute-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, peuple d’Israël, descendants de Jacob, toi que j’ai appelé. \q Moi seul, je suis Dieu. \q J’étais là au commencement, et je serai là à la fin.

sw.L: Nisikilize, Yakobo, na Israeli, aliyeitwa na {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}: \q {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndiye; {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] wa kwanza, pia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] wa mwisho.
sw.B: Nisikie, Yakobo, Israeli, yule niliyemwita: \q Mimi ndiye. Mimi ni wa kwanza; {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} pia ni wa mwisho.
sw.R: Nisikilizeni, enyi watu wa Israeli, wazao wa Yakobo, ambao nimewaita. \q Mimi ndiye niliye Mungu. \q Nilikuwepo mwanzoni, nami nitakuwepo mwishoni.

vi.L: Hãy nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hỡi Gia-cốp, và Y-sơ-ra-ên, kẻ được {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gọi: \q Ta [là] Đấng ấy; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] đầu tiên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng [là] cuối cùng.
vi.B: Hãy nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hỡi Gia-cốp, hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã gọi: \q Ta là Đấng ấy. Ta là Đấng đầu tiên; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng là Đấng cuối cùng.
vi.R: Hãy nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, con cháu Gia-cốp, những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã gọi. \q Chỉ một mình {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Đức Chúa Trời. \q Ta đã có mặt từ ban đầu, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ có mặt vào lúc cuối cùng.

decisions.choice: I am he: I am the one, the only God
decisions.reason: The short phrase is God's claim to be the one true God, repeated through these chapters (41:4; 43:10, 13; 46:4; Deuteronomy 32:39).

decisions.choice: the first and the last: God was before all things and will remain after them
decisions.reason: The title is used in 41:4 and 44:6. In Revelation the risen Christ takes it for himself (Revelation 1:17; 2:8; 22:13).

decisions.choice: my called one: Israel, called by God to belong to him
decisions.reason: God called Israel to be his people and his servant (41:9; 42:6; 43:1).

decisions.choice: people of Israel, descendants of Jacob; I am the one who is God; I was there at the beginning, and I will be there at the end
decisions.reason: Readable names Jacob and Israel as the people, and explains "I am he" and "the first and the last" in plain words.

source.text: אַף־יָדִי֙ יָ֣סְדָה אֶ֔רֶץ וִֽימִינִ֖י טִפְּחָ֣ה שָׁמָ֑יִם קֹרֵ֥א אֲנִ֛י אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יַעַמְד֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃

records.literal_gloss: Also my hand founded [the] earth, and my right hand spread out [the] heavens; [am] calling I to them, they stand together.

en.L: Also {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand founded [the] earth, \q and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} right hand spread out [the] heavens; \q I call to them, [and] they stand together.
en.B: My own hand set the earth on its foundations, \q and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} right hand stretched the heavens wide; \q at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} call they rise and stand together.
en.R: With {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own hand I set the earth firmly in place. \q With {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} right hand I spread out the sky. \q When I call the earth and sky, they all stand up, ready to obey.

es.L: También {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano fundó la tierra, \q y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} diestra extendió los cielos; \q yo los llamo, [y] se presentan juntos.
es.B: Mi propia mano puso los cimientos de la tierra, \q y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} diestra desplegó los cielos; \q a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} llamado se levantan y se presentan juntos.
es.R: Con {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} propia mano afirmé la tierra en su lugar. \q Con {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano derecha extendí el cielo. \q Cuando llamo a la tierra y al cielo, todos se ponen de pie, listos para obedecer.

fr.L: Aussi {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main a fondé la terre, \q et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} droite a déployé les cieux ; \q je les appelle, [et] ils se tiennent là ensemble.
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main qui a posé les fondations de la terre, \q et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} droite qui a largement déployé les cieux ; \q à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} appel, ils se lèvent et se tiennent ensemble.
fr.R: De {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} propre main, j’ai solidement placé la terre. \q De {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main droite, j’ai étendu le ciel. \q Quand j’appelle la terre et le ciel, ils se lèvent tous, prêts à obéir.

sw.L: Pia mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} uliweka misingi ya dunia, \q na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wa kuume ulizitandaza mbingu; \q ninaziita, [nazo] zinasimama pamoja.
sw.B: Mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mwenyewe uliiweka dunia juu ya misingi yake, \q na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wa kuume ulizitandaza mbingu kwa upana; \q ninapoziita, zinainuka na kusimama pamoja.
sw.R: Kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mwenyewe niliiweka dunia imara mahali pake. \q Kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wa kuume nilitandaza anga. \q Ninapoita dunia na anga, vyote vinasimama, tayari kutii.

vi.L: Tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng đã lập nền đất, \q và tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã trải các tầng trời ra; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gọi chúng, [và] chúng cùng nhau đứng dậy.
vi.B: Chính tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đặt nền cho trái đất, \q và tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giăng rộng các tầng trời; \q khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gọi, chúng cùng nhau đứng dậy.
vi.R: Chính tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đặt trái đất vững vàng. \q Tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giăng bầu trời ra. \q Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gọi đất và trời, chúng đều đứng dậy, sẵn sàng vâng lời.

decisions.choice: spread out: stretched out the heavens like a tent or a hand spread wide
decisions.reason: The verb is related to the word for the breadth of a hand. God's spreading out of the heavens is a frequent picture in these chapters (40:22; 42:5; 44:24; 45:12).

decisions.choice: I call to them, they stand together: the earth and heavens stand ready at God's summons
decisions.reason: The heavens and earth are pictured as servants who rise and stand to receive orders when their master calls (40:26).

decisions.choice: the sky; the earth and sky; ready to obey
decisions.reason: Readable says "sky" for the heavens, names what "them" refers to, and explains why they stand.

source.text: הִקָּבְצ֤וּ כֻלְּכֶם֙ וּֽשֲׁמָ֔עוּ מִ֥י בָהֶ֖ם הִגִּ֣יד אֶת־אֵ֑לֶּה יְהוָ֣ה אֲהֵב֔וֹ יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה חֶפְצוֹ֙ בְּבָבֶ֔ל וּזְרֹע֖וֹ כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Gather together, all of you, and listen: who among them has declared these [things]? Yahweh loves him; he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm [on the] Chaldeans.

en.L: Gather together, all of you, and listen! \q Who among them declared these [things]? \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} loves him; he will do {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} pleasure on Babylon, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arm [will be on the] Chaldeans.
en.B: All of you, gather and hear! \q Which of them announced these things? \q The one {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} loves will carry out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} purpose against Babylon, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arm will be turned against the Chaldeans.
en.R: All of you, come together and listen. \q Which of the idols told you about these things? \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} loves this man, and he will do what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} wants to Babylon. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will use {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power against the Babylonians.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Reúnanse todos ustedes, y escuchen|Reuníos todos vosotros, y escuchad}}! \q ¿Quién de ellos anunció estas [cosas]? \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo ama; él hará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad en Babilonia, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} brazo [estará sobre] los caldeos.
es.B: ¡Todos {{plural_you:ustedes, reúnanse y escuchen|vosotros, reuníos y escuchad}}! \q ¿Cuál de ellos anunció estas cosas? \q Aquel a quien {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ama llevará a cabo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propósito contra Babilonia, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} brazo se volverá contra los caldeos.
es.R: Todos {{plural_you:ustedes, reúnanse y escuchen|vosotros, reuníos y escuchad}}. \q ¿Cuál de los ídolos {{plural_you:les|os}} habló de estas cosas? \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ama a este hombre, y él hará con Babilonia lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quiere. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} usará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder contra los babilonios.

fr.L: Rassemblez-vous, vous tous, et écoutez ! \q Qui parmi eux a annoncé ces [choses] ? \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’aime ; il accomplira {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bon plaisir sur Babylone, \q et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras [sera sur les] Chaldéens.
fr.B: Vous tous, rassemblez-vous et écoutez ! \q Lequel d’entre eux a annoncé ces choses ? \q Celui que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aime accomplira {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté contre Babylone, \q et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras se tournera contre les Chaldéens.
fr.R: Vous tous, réunissez-vous et écoutez. \q Laquelle des idoles vous a parlé de ces choses ? \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aime cet homme, et il fera à Babylone ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} veut. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se servira de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance contre les Babyloniens.

sw.L: Kusanyikeni, nyote, mkasikie! \q Ni nani miongoni mwao aliyetangaza mambo haya? \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anampenda; atatenda mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} juu ya Babeli, \q na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} [utakuwa juu ya] Wakaldayo.
sw.B: Ninyi nyote, kusanyikeni mkasikie! \q Ni yupi kati yao aliyetangaza mambo haya? \q Yule ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anampenda atatimiza kusudi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} dhidi ya Babeli, \q na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} utageuzwa dhidi ya Wakaldayo.
sw.R: Ninyi nyote, njooni pamoja msikilize. \q Ni sanamu ipi iliyowaambia habari za mambo haya? \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anampenda mtu huyu, naye atafanya kile ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anataka kwa Babeli. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} dhidi ya Wababeli.

vi.L: Hãy nhóm lại, tất cả các ngươi, và hãy nghe! \q Ai trong chúng đã báo những [việc] này? \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} yêu người; người sẽ làm điều đẹp ý {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên Ba-by-lôn, \q và cánh tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [sẽ ở trên] người Canh-đê.
vi.B: Hỡi tất cả các ngươi, hãy tụ họp lại mà nghe! \q Thần nào trong chúng đã báo trước những việc này? \q Người mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} yêu sẽ thực hiện ý định của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên Ba-by-lôn, \q và cánh tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ giáng xuống người Canh-đê.
vi.R: Tất cả các ngươi hãy đến với nhau và lắng nghe. \q Thần tượng nào đã nói cho các ngươi biết những việc này? \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} yêu người này, và người sẽ làm cho Ba-by-lôn điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} muốn. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ dùng quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chống lại người Ba-by-lôn.

decisions.choice: who among them: which of the idols or the nations' gods
decisions.reason: As in 41:22-26 and 43:9, the challenge is for the other gods to show that they foretold events. None of them did.

decisions.choice: the LORD loves him: the one God has called, most likely Cyrus, who is not named here
decisions.reason: Verse 15 says God called him and brought him, and earlier chapters name Cyrus as the one who will carry out God's purpose against Babylon (44:28; 45:1-4; 46:11). The words could be read of Israel, but "him" is the one who acts against Babylon.

decisions.choice: his purpose, his arm: the LORD's purpose and power, worked out through the one he loves
alternatives: his own purpose and his own power
decisions.reason: In 44:28 God says of Cyrus that "he will carry out all my purpose", and the arm of the LORD is a frequent picture of his power in these chapters (40:10; 51:9; 52:10). The pronouns could instead refer to Cyrus's own wish and strength.

decisions.choice: which of the idols; this man; what the LORD wants; the LORD will use his power
decisions.reason: Readable names the idols and explains "pleasure" and "arm", following the meaning decisions above. Calling Babylon's people "Babylonians" follows the settled wording for the Chaldeans.

decisions.choice: lo ama; él (no deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: The one the LORD loves is most likely Cyrus, so his pronoun "él" takes no deity_pronoun span, while "su voluntad", "su brazo" (the LORD's) do, as in the English.

source.text: אֲנִ֥י אֲנִ֛י דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אַף־קְרָאתִ֑יו הֲבִיאֹתִ֖יו וְהִצְלִ֥יחַ דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: I, I have spoken; also I have called him; I have brought him, and he will make prosper his way.

en.L: I, I have spoken; also I have called him; \q I have brought him, and he will make his way succeed.
en.B: It is I, I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}}, who have spoken; I also summoned him. \q I have brought him, and he will carry his journey through to success.
en.R: I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} have spoken. I called him. \q I brought him here, and he will succeed in what he sets out to do.

es.L: Yo, yo he hablado; también lo he llamado; \q lo he traído, y él hará prosperar su camino.
es.B: Soy yo, yo mismo, quien ha hablado; yo también lo llamé. \q Lo he traído, y él llevará su camino a buen término.
es.R: Yo mismo he hablado. Yo lo llamé. \q Lo traje aquí, y tendrá éxito en lo que se proponga.

fr.L: Moi, moi, j’ai parlé ; aussi je l’ai appelé ; \q je l’ai fait venir, et il fera réussir son chemin.
fr.B: C’est moi, {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}, qui ai parlé ; c’est moi aussi qui l’ai appelé. \q Je l’ai fait venir, et il mènera sa route jusqu’au succès.
fr.R: C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}} qui ai parlé. Je l’ai appelé. \q Je l’ai fait venir, et il réussira dans ce qu’il entreprend.

sw.L: Mimi, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nimesema; pia nimemwita; \q nimemleta, naye ataifanikisha njia yake.
sw.B: Ni mimi, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, niliyesema; pia nilimwita. \q Nimemleta, naye atafanikiwa katika safari yake.
sw.R: Mimi {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} nimesema. Nilimwita. \q Nilimleta hapa, naye atafanikiwa katika kazi anayoianza.

vi.L: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng đã gọi người; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đem người đến, và người sẽ làm cho đường lối mình được thành công.
vi.B: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, phải, chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng đã gọi người. \q Ta đã đem người đến, và người sẽ đi trọn đường mình cách thành công.
vi.R: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán. Ta đã gọi người. \q Ta đã đem người đến đây, và người sẽ thành công trong việc mình định làm.

decisions.choice: I, I: the doubled pronoun stresses that God alone did this
decisions.reason: God repeats "I" to set himself apart from the idols (43:11, 25; 51:12).

decisions.choice: he will make his way succeed: the one God called will succeed in his task
alternatives: I will make his way succeed
decisions.reason: The verb is third person: the one called will prosper in his way. The Septuagint has "I made his way prosper" (cited from memory; to be checked), making God the one who gives success. Either way, the success comes from God's call.

source.text: קִרְב֧וּ אֵלַ֣י שִׁמְעוּ־זֹ֗את לֹ֤א מֵרֹאשׁ֙ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי מֵעֵ֥ת הֱיוֹתָ֖הּ שָׁ֣ם אָ֑נִי וְעַתָּ֗ה אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה שְׁלָחַ֖נִי וְרוּחֽוֹ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Draw near to me, listen to this: not from [the] beginning in secret have I spoken; from [the] time [of] its happening there [was] I. And now [the] Lord Yahweh has sent me, and his Spirit.

en.L: Draw near to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, hear this: not from [the] beginning in secret have I spoken; \q from [the] time [it] happened, there [was] I. \q And now the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} has sent me, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit.
en.B: Come close to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and listen: never, from the start, have I spoken in hiding; \q from the moment it began, I was present. \q And now the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} has sent me, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit.
en.R: Come near to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and listen. From the beginning I have not kept {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words secret. \q I was there when all this began to happen. \q And now the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} has sent me, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit too.

es.L: {{plural_you:Acérquense|Acercaos}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, {{plural_you:oigan|oíd}} esto: desde el principio no he hablado en secreto; \q desde el tiempo en que [esto] sucedió, allí [estaba] yo. \q Y ahora el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} me ha enviado, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu.
es.B: {{plural_you:Acérquense|Acercaos}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}}: nunca, desde el comienzo, he hablado a escondidas; \q desde el momento en que comenzó, yo estaba presente. \q Y ahora el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} me ha enviado, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu.
es.R: {{plural_you:Acérquense|Acercaos}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}}. Desde el principio no he mantenido en secreto {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras. \q Yo estaba allí cuando todo esto comenzó a suceder. \q Y ahora el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} me ha enviado, y también {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu.

fr.L: Approchez-vous de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, écoutez ceci : dès le commencement je n’ai pas parlé en secret ; \q depuis le temps où [cela] est arrivé, moi, j’étais là. \q Et maintenant le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} m’a envoyé, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit.
fr.B: Approchez-vous de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et écoutez : jamais, dès le début, je n’ai parlé en cachette ; \q depuis le moment où cela a commencé, j’étais présent. \q Et maintenant le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} m’a envoyé, avec {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit.
fr.R: Approchez-vous de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et écoutez. Depuis le commencement, je n’ai pas gardé {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles secrètes. \q J’étais là quand tout cela a commencé à arriver. \q Et maintenant, le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} m’a envoyé, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit aussi.

sw.L: Nikaribieni, sikieni hili: tangu mwanzo sikusema kwa siri; \q tangu wakati [lilipotokea], {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nilikuwepo. \q Na sasa Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} amenituma, pamoja na Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Njooni karibu {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} mkasikilize: tangu mwanzo sijawahi kusema mafichoni; \q tangu wakati lilipoanza, nilikuwepo. \q Na sasa Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} amenituma, pamoja na Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Njooni karibu {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} mkasikilize. Tangu mwanzo sikuyaficha maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Nilikuwepo mambo haya yote yalipoanza kutokea. \q Na sasa Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} amenituma, pamoja na Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} pia.

vi.L: Hãy đến gần {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hãy nghe điều này: từ ban đầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không hề phán trong chỗ kín; \q từ lúc [nó] xảy ra, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [đã ở] đó. \q Và bây giờ Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai tôi, cùng với Thần Linh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy đến gần {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà nghe: ngay từ đầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa hề phán trong chỗ kín; \q từ lúc việc ấy bắt đầu, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã có mặt. \q Và bây giờ Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai tôi, cùng với Thần Linh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Hãy đến gần {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và lắng nghe. Từ ban đầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã không giữ kín lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Ta đã ở đó khi mọi việc này bắt đầu xảy ra. \q Và bây giờ Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai tôi, và sai cả Thần Linh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nữa.

decisions.choice: has sent me: a new speaker, probably the prophet, sent with God's message
decisions.reason: Until "I was there" God speaks. The one who now says "the Lord GOD has sent me" cannot be the Lord GOD who sends him, so the speaker changes without warning. He may be the prophet. He may be the servant of the LORD, who speaks of himself in the same way in 49:1-6 and 50:4-9, and on whom the Spirit rests in 42:1 and 61:1. Cyrus has also been suggested, since he is the one called in verse 15. The verse has also been read of the Messiah, sent by God and his Spirit.

decisions.choice: and his Spirit: either sent with the speaker, or sending him together with the Lord GOD
alternatives: the Lord GOD and his Spirit have sent me
the Lord GOD has sent me with his Spirit
decisions.reason: The Hebrew allows "the Lord GOD has sent me, and has sent his Spirit" or "the Lord GOD and his Spirit have sent me". The renderings keep the Hebrew order so that both readings remain open.

decisions.choice: his Spirit: the Spirit of God, his presence and power at work
decisions.reason: The Spirit of the LORD rests on the one God sends (11:2; 42:1; 61:1) and is present among his people (63:10-11).

decisions.choice: from the time it happened, I was there: God was present when events began
decisions.reason: The events God foretold did not take him by surprise: he was there as they came about, because he brought them about (verse 3).

decisions.choice: el Señor DIOS
decisions.reason: Book-wide in this block: Adonai YHWH is "el Señor" with "DIOS" in a divine_name span, as the terms note sets it; the new speaker's "me" (probably the prophet) takes no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: Bwana MUNGU
decisions.reason: "The Lord GOD" is "Bwana" with the divine name MUNGU in a span, as the terms note sets it; the speaker sent here is not God (meaning decision m1), so "-ni-" (me) in "amenituma" has no span.

decisions.choice: "le Seigneur DIEU"
decisions.reason: *Adonai YHWH* is "le Seigneur DIEU", with "DIEU" under the divine_name setting, as the Pentateuch and Kings notes settle; the speaker sent here ("m'a envoyé") takes no deity_pronoun span. Settled for chapters 41-66.

decisions.choice: "Chúa là CHÚA ... đã sai tôi": the new speaker says "tôi"
decisions.reason: In the last line a different speaker (the prophet or the servant) speaks of himself; as the terms note settles for the speaker of 61:1, he says "tôi" and takes no deity_pronoun span. "The Lord GOD" is "Chúa là CHÚA", as in Samuel and the Psalms.

source.text: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה גֹּאַלְךָ֖ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ מְלַמֶּדְךָ֣ לְהוֹעִ֔יל מַדְרִֽיכֲךָ֖ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ תֵּלֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: I [am] Yahweh your God, teaching you to profit, leading you in [the] way [that] you will go.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: \q I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, [who] teaches you to profit, \q [who] leads you in the way [that] you should go.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says this: \q I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, who teaches you what is for your good \q and guides you along the road you are to walk.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says, the Holy One of Israel, who rescues you: \q I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. I teach you what is good for you. \q I lead you on the road you should take.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, tu Redentor, el Santo de Israel: \q Yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, [que] te enseña para provecho, \q [que] te guía por el camino [en que] debes andar.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, tu Redentor, el Santo de Israel, dice esto: \q Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, que te enseña lo que es para tu bien \q y te guía por el camino que debes seguir.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Santo de Israel, el que te rescata: \q Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios. Te enseño lo que es bueno para ti. \q Te guío por el camino que debes tomar.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ton Rédempteur, le Saint d’Israël : \q Je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, [qui] t’enseigne pour [ton] profit, \q [qui] te conduis dans le chemin [où] tu dois marcher.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ton Libérateur, le Saint d’Israël, dit ceci : \q Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, qui t’enseigne ce qui est bon pour toi \q et te guide sur la route que tu dois suivre.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Saint d’Israël, celui qui te délivre : \q Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Je t’enseigne ce qui est bon pour toi. \q Je te conduis sur le chemin que tu dois prendre.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi, Mkombozi wako, Mtakatifu wa Israeli: \q Mimi [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, [nikufundishaye] kupata faida, \q [nikuongozaye] katika njia [ikupasayo] kuiendea.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo, Mkombozi wako, Mtakatifu wa Israeli: \q Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, ninayekufundisha yaliyo kwa faida yako \q na kukuongoza katika njia unayopaswa kuifuata.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema, Mtakatifu wa Israeli, anayekuokoa: \q Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Ninakufundisha yaliyo mema kwako. \q Ninakuongoza katika njia unayopaswa kuifuata.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng Cứu Chuộc của ngươi, Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: \q Ta [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi, [Đấng] dạy ngươi để được ích lợi, \q [Đấng] dẫn ngươi trên con đường ngươi phải đi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng Cứu Chuộc của con, Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy: \q Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của con, Đấng dạy con điều ích lợi cho con \q và dẫn con theo con đường con phải đi.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên, Đấng giải cứu con: \q Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của con. Ta dạy con điều tốt cho con. \q Ta dẫn con đi trên con đường con nên đi.

decisions.choice: Redeemer: the one who buys back or frees a relative, used of God
decisions.reason: A redeemer was the close relative who bought back family land or freed a family member sold into slavery (Leviticus 25:25, 47-49). God is Israel's Redeemer throughout these chapters (41:14; 43:14; 44:6, 24).

decisions.choice: teaches you to profit: teaches you what is for your benefit
decisions.reason: The same verb is used of idols that "do not profit" (44:9-10; 47:12; 57:12). Unlike them, God's teaching does Israel real good.

decisions.choice: who rescues you
decisions.reason: Readable explains "Redeemer" as the one who rescues, following the settled wording.

source.text: ל֥וּא הִקְשַׁ֖בְתָּ לְמִצְוֺתָ֑י וַיְהִ֤י כַנָּהָר֙ שְׁלוֹמֶ֔ךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֖ כְּגַלֵּ֥י הַיָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: If you had paid attention to my commandments, and it was like the river your peace, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.

en.L: If only you had paid attention to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commands! \q And your peace would have been like a river, \q and your righteousness like [the] waves of the sea.
en.B: If only you had heeded {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commands! \q Then your peace would have run like a river, \q and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.
en.R: I wish you had obeyed {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commands! \q Then your peace would have kept flowing like a river. \q Your righteousness would have kept rolling in like the waves of the sea.

es.L: ¡Si hubieras atendido a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos! \q Tu paz habría sido como un río, \q y tu justicia como las olas del mar.
es.B: ¡Si tan solo hubieras hecho caso de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos! \q Tu paz habría corrido como un río, \q y tu justicia como las olas del mar.
es.R: ¡Cómo quisiera que hubieras obedecido {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos! \q Entonces tu paz habría seguido fluyendo como un río. \q Tu justicia habría seguido llegando como las olas del mar.

fr.L: Si seulement tu avais été attentif à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements ! \q Et ta paix aurait été comme un fleuve, \q et ta justice comme les vagues de la mer.
fr.B: Si seulement tu avais écouté {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements ! \q Alors ta paix aurait coulé comme un fleuve, \q et ta justice comme les vagues de la mer.
fr.R: Si seulement tu avais obéi à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements ! \q Alors ta paix aurait coulé sans fin comme une rivière. \q Ta justice aurait déferlé sans cesse comme les vagues de la mer.

sw.L: Laiti ungalisikiliza amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}! \q Na amani yako ingalikuwa kama mto, \q na haki yako kama mawimbi ya bahari.
sw.B: Laiti ungalizitii amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}! \q Ndipo amani yako ingalitiririka kama mto, \q na haki yako kama mawimbi ya bahari.
sw.R: Ninatamani ungalizitii amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}! \q Ndipo amani yako ingaliendelea kutiririka kama mto. \q Haki yako ingaliendelea kuja kama mawimbi ya bahari.

vi.L: Ước gì ngươi đã chú tâm đến các điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! \q Thì sự bình an ngươi đã như dòng sông, \q và sự công chính ngươi như sóng biển.
vi.B: Ước gì con đã lưu tâm đến các điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! \q Thì bình an của con đã tuôn chảy như dòng sông, \q và sự công chính của con như những đợt sóng biển.
vi.R: Ước gì con đã vâng theo các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! \q Thì bình an của con đã cứ tuôn chảy như dòng sông. \q Sự công chính của con đã cứ dâng lên như sóng biển.

decisions.choice: if only you had paid attention: a wish about the past that did not come true
decisions.reason: The particle with a past verb expresses regret over what could have been. God says the same in Deuteronomy 32:29 and Psalm 81:14-17.

decisions.choice: your peace, your righteousness: well-being and right standing, the blessings of keeping God's commands
decisions.reason: Peace here is wholeness and prosperity. Righteousness, set beside it, is the right standing and the deliverance that go with it (45:8; 46:13). A river that never fails and waves that never stop picture blessing without end.

decisions.choice: run like a river; kept flowing; kept rolling in
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add the motion that the pictures of the river and the waves imply.

source.text: וַיְהִ֤י כַחוֹל֙ זַרְעֶ֔ךָ וְצֶאֱצָאֵ֥י מֵעֶ֖יךָ כִּמְעֹתָ֑יו לֹֽא־יִכָּרֵ֧ת וְֽלֹא־יִשָּׁמֵ֛ד שְׁמ֖וֹ מִלְּפָנָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was like the sand your offspring, and the descendants of your inward parts like its grains; it will not be cut off and it will not be destroyed its name from before me.

en.L: And your offspring would have been like the sand, \q and the descendants of your body like its grains; \q its name would not be cut off and would not be destroyed from before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: Your descendants would have been as many as the sand, \q your own children like its grains; \q their name would never be cut off or wiped out from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} presence.
en.R: You would have had as many descendants as there are grains of sand. \q Their name would never have been wiped out or destroyed from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight.

es.L: Y tu descendencia habría sido como la arena, \q y los vástagos de tus entrañas como sus granos; \q su nombre no habría sido cortado ni destruido de delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.B: Tus descendientes habrían sido tantos como la arena, \q tus propios hijos como sus granos; \q su nombre nunca habría sido cortado ni borrado de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} presencia.
es.R: Habrías tenido tantos descendientes como granos de arena. \q Su nombre nunca habría sido borrado ni destruido de delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.

fr.L: Et ta descendance aurait été comme le sable, \q et les rejetons de tes entrailles comme ses grains ; \q son nom n’aurait pas été retranché ni détruit de devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.B: Tes descendants auraient été aussi nombreux que le sable, \q tes propres enfants comme ses grains ; \q leur nom n’aurait jamais été retranché ni effacé de devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.R: Tu aurais eu autant de descendants qu’il y a de grains de sable. \q Leur nom n’aurait jamais été effacé ni détruit devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Na uzao wako ungalikuwa kama mchanga, \q na wazao wa viuno vyako kama chembe zake; \q jina lake lisingalikatiliwa mbali wala kuangamizwa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.B: Wazao wako wangalikuwa wengi kama mchanga, \q watoto wako mwenyewe kama chembe zake; \q jina lao lisingalikatiliwa mbali wala kufutwa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.R: Ungalikuwa na wazao wengi kama chembe za mchanga. \q Jina lao lisingalifutwa wala kuangamizwa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

vi.L: Và dòng dõi ngươi đã như cát, \q và con cháu ra từ lòng ngươi như hạt cát; \q danh nó sẽ không bị diệt trừ và sẽ không bị tiêu hủy khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Dòng dõi con đã đông như cát, \q con cái ruột thịt của con đã nhiều như hạt cát; \q danh của chúng sẽ chẳng bao giờ bị diệt trừ hay xóa bỏ khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Con đã có con cháu đông như cát biển. \q Tên của chúng sẽ chẳng bao giờ bị xóa bỏ hay tiêu diệt khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

decisions.choice: your offspring like the sand: the promise to Abraham
decisions.reason: God promised Abraham and Jacob descendants as many as the sand of the seashore (Genesis 22:17; 32:13). Israel's disobedience kept it from enjoying the promise in full.

decisions.choice: the descendants of your inward parts: your own children, born of your body
decisions.reason: The inward parts are the body as the source of children (Genesis 15:4; 2 Samuel 7:12).

decisions.choice: its name would not be cut off: still part of the unfulfilled wish
alternatives: its name will not be cut off
decisions.reason: The verbs may continue the regret of verse 18 (what would have been) or turn to a promise that the people's name will not be cut off. "Its name" refers to the offspring, or to Israel itself.

source.text: צְא֣וּ מִבָּבֶל֮ בִּרְח֣וּ מִכַּשְׂדִּים֒ בְּק֣וֹל רִנָּ֗ה הַגִּ֤ידוּ הַשְׁמִ֨יעוּ֙ זֹ֔את הוֹצִיא֖וּהָ עַד־קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ אִמְר֕וּ גָּאַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה עַבְדּ֥וֹ יַעֲקֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: Go out from Babylon, flee from [the] Chaldeans; with a voice of a shout of joy declare, make heard this, send it out to [the] end of the earth; say, Yahweh has redeemed his servant Jacob.

en.L: Go out from Babylon; flee from [the] Chaldeans! \q With a voice of joyful shouting declare, make this heard, \q send it out to [the] end of the earth; \q say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has redeemed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant Jacob!"
en.B: Go out of Babylon! Escape from the Chaldeans! \q Raise a joyful cry and tell it; let this be heard, \q sent out to the far ends of the earth. \q Say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has redeemed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant Jacob!"
