en.R: Leave Babylon! Run away from the Babylonians! \q Shout for joy and tell everyone this news. \q Send the message to the farthest places on earth. \q Say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has rescued {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant, the people of Jacob!"

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Salgan|Salid}} de Babilonia; {{plural_you:huyan|huid}} de los caldeos! \q Con voz de júbilo {{plural_you:anuncien, hagan|anunciad, haced}} oír esto, \q {{plural_you:llévenlo|llevadlo}} hasta el extremo de la tierra; \q {{plural_you:digan|decid}}: «¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha redimido a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo Jacob!».
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Salgan|Salid}} de Babilonia! ¡{{plural_you:Escapen|Escapad}} de los caldeos! \q {{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} un grito de alegría y {{plural_you:anúncienlo|anunciadlo}}; que esto se oiga, \q que llegue hasta los confines de la tierra. \q {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}}: «¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha redimido a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo Jacob!».
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Salgan|Salid}} de Babilonia! ¡{{plural_you:Huyan|Huid}} de los babilonios! \q {{plural_you:Griten|Gritad}} de alegría y {{plural_you:cuéntenles|contadles}} a todos esta noticia. \q {{plural_you:Envíen|Enviad}} el mensaje hasta los lugares más lejanos de la tierra. \q {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}}: «¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha rescatado a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo, el pueblo de Jacob!».

fr.L: Sortez de Babylone ; fuyez loin des Chaldéens ! \q Avec une voix de cris de joie annoncez, faites entendre ceci, \q faites-le parvenir jusqu’à l’extrémité de la terre ; \q dites : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a racheté {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur Jacob ! »
fr.B: Sortez de Babylone ! Échappez aux Chaldéens ! \q Avec des cris de joie, annoncez-le ; faites entendre ceci, \q répandez-le jusqu’au bout de la terre. \q Dites : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a racheté {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur Jacob ! »
fr.R: Quittez Babylone ! Fuyez loin des Babyloniens ! \q Criez de joie et annoncez cette nouvelle à tout le monde. \q Envoyez le message jusqu’aux endroits les plus lointains de la terre. \q Dites : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a délivré {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, le peuple de Jacob ! »

sw.L: Tokeni Babeli; kimbieni kutoka kwa Wakaldayo! \q Kwa sauti ya shangwe tangazeni, lisikizisheni hili, \q lipelekeni hadi mwisho wa dunia; \q semeni, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemkomboa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Yakobo!"
sw.B: Tokeni Babeli! Ponyokeni kutoka kwa Wakaldayo! \q Pazeni sauti ya shangwe na kulitangaza; hili na lisikike, \q lipelekwe hadi miisho ya mbali ya dunia. \q Semeni, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemkomboa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Yakobo!"
sw.R: Ondokeni Babeli! Wakimbieni Wababeli! \q Pigeni kelele kwa furaha na kumwambia kila mtu habari hii. \q Ipelekeni habari hii hadi mahali pa mbali kabisa duniani. \q Semeni, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemwokoa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, watu wa Yakobo!"

vi.L: Hãy ra khỏi Ba-by-lôn; hãy trốn khỏi người Canh-đê! \q Hãy dùng tiếng reo vui mà báo tin, hãy cho người ta nghe điều này, \q hãy truyền nó ra đến tận cùng đất; \q hãy nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cứu chuộc Gia-cốp, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!"
vi.B: Hãy ra khỏi Ba-by-lôn! Hãy trốn khỏi người Canh-đê! \q Hãy cất tiếng reo vui mà loan báo; hãy cho mọi người nghe điều này, \q truyền ra đến tận cùng mặt đất. \q Hãy nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cứu chuộc Gia-cốp, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!"
vi.R: Hãy rời khỏi Ba-by-lôn! Hãy chạy trốn khỏi người Ba-by-lôn! \q Hãy reo hò vui mừng và báo tin này cho mọi người. \q Hãy gửi lời ấy đến những nơi xa nhất trên đất. \q Hãy nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giải cứu dân Gia-cốp, đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!"

decisions.choice: go out from Babylon: God's call to leave exile, a new exodus
decisions.reason: The command to leave is repeated in 52:11-12 and Jeremiah 50:8; 51:6, 45, and taken up in Revelation 18:4. The flight recalls Israel's leaving Egypt (verse 21).

decisions.choice: has redeemed: has bought back and set free, as a near relative would
decisions.reason: See verse 17. The verb is in the past tense: the release is announced as already done.

decisions.choice: his servant Jacob: the people of Israel, the LORD's servant
decisions.reason: Israel is called God's servant Jacob in 41:8; 44:1-2, 21; 45:4.

decisions.choice: rescued; the people of Jacob
decisions.reason: Readable says "rescued" for "redeemed" and names Jacob as the people descended from him, following the settled wording.

source.text: וְלֹ֣א צָמְא֗וּ בָּחֳרָבוֹת֙ הֽוֹלִיכָ֔ם מַ֥יִם מִצּ֖וּר הִזִּ֣יל לָ֑מוֹ וַיִּ֨בְקַע־צ֔וּר וַיָּזֻ֖בוּ מָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And not they thirsted in the waste places [where] he led them; water from a rock he made flow for them; and he split [the] rock, and they flowed out waters.

en.L: And they did not thirst [in] the waste places [where] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} led them; \q water from [the] rock {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made flow for them; \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} split [the] rock, and [the] water gushed out.
en.B: They knew no thirst as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} guided them through dry wastes; \q for them {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought water streaming out of the rock; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} broke the rock open, and out poured the water.
en.R: When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} led {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people through the desert, they were not thirsty. \q He made water flow out of a rock for them. \q He split the rock open, and water poured out.

es.L: Y no tuvieron sed [en] los desiertos [por donde] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los llevó; \q agua de la roca {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hizo brotar para ellos; \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} partió la roca, y brotaron las aguas.
es.B: No pasaron sed cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los guio por lugares desolados; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hizo que el agua brotara de la roca para ellos; \q partió la roca, y el agua salió a raudales.
es.R: Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} guio a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo por el desierto, no tuvieron sed. \q Él hizo salir agua de una roca para ellos. \q Partió la roca, y el agua brotó.

fr.L: Et ils n’ont pas eu soif dans les lieux dévastés [où] {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a conduits ; \q l’eau du rocher, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a fait couler pour eux ; \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fendu le rocher, et les eaux ont jailli.
fr.B: Ils n’ont pas connu la soif quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a guidés à travers les déserts ; \q pour eux {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait jaillir l’eau du rocher ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fendu le rocher, et l’eau s’est mise à couler.
fr.R: Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a conduit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple à travers le désert, ils n’ont pas eu soif. \q Il a fait couler de l’eau d’un rocher pour eux. \q Il a fendu le rocher, et l’eau a jailli.

sw.L: Wala hawakuona kiu [katika] jangwa [alikowaongoza]; \q maji kutoka mwambani aliwatiririshia; \q aliupasua mwamba, na maji yakabubujika.
sw.B: Hawakuona kiu alipowaongoza katika nyika kavu; \q aliwatoa maji yakitiririka kutoka mwambani; \q aliupasua mwamba, na maji yakamiminika.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipowaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} jangwani, hawakuona kiu. \q Alifanya maji yatoke mwambani kwa ajili yao. \q Aliupasua mwamba, na maji yakamiminika.

vi.L: Và họ đã không khát [trong] những nơi hoang vu [nơi] {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dẫn họ đi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã khiến nước từ vầng đá chảy ra cho họ; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chẻ vầng đá, và nước đã tuôn ra.
vi.B: Họ chẳng hề khát khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dẫn họ qua những vùng hoang vu; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khiến nước từ vầng đá tuôn chảy cho họ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chẻ vầng đá ra, và nước tràn ra.
vi.R: Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dẫn dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi qua sa mạc, họ không bị khát. \q Ngài làm cho nước chảy ra từ vầng đá cho họ. \q Ngài chẻ vầng đá ra, và nước tuôn trào.

decisions.choice: water from the rock: the miracle in the wilderness after the exodus
decisions.reason: God gave Israel water from the rock in Exodus 17:6 and Numbers 20:11, and the psalms recall it (Psalm 78:15-16, 20; 105:41).

decisions.choice: they did not thirst when he led them: told in the past tense, as in the first exodus
alternatives: they will not thirst when he leads them
decisions.reason: The verbs are past. The verse may recall the first exodus as a pledge of what God will do for those leaving Babylon, or describe the coming journey as already done (41:17-18; 43:19-20).

decisions.choice: the LORD led his people
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who led and the people as those he led, since the verse uses only pronouns.

source.text: אֵ֣ין שָׁל֔וֹם אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה לָרְשָׁעִֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: There is not peace, says Yahweh, for the wicked.

en.L: There is no peace, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for the wicked.
en.B: There is no peace, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for the wicked.
en.R: There is no peace for people who do evil, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: No hay paz, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, para los malvados.
es.B: No hay paz, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, para los malvados.
es.R: No hay paz para los que hacen el mal, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Il n’y a pas de paix, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour les méchants.
fr.B: Il n’y a pas de paix, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour les méchants.
fr.R: Il n’y a pas de paix pour ceux qui font le mal, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Hakuna amani, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa waovu.
sw.B: Hakuna amani, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa waovu.
sw.R: Hakuna amani kwa watu wanaotenda maovu, \q anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Chẳng có bình an, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, cho kẻ ác.
vi.B: Kẻ ác chẳng có bình an, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.R: Những kẻ làm điều ác sẽ không có bình an, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

decisions.choice: there is no peace for the wicked: a closing warning
decisions.reason: The same words close 57:21, and with 66:24 they mark the ends of the last sections of the book. After the promise of release, the warning applies to the wicked in Israel as well as outside it.

decisions.choice: peace: well-being and wholeness
decisions.reason: The peace that obedience would have brought (verse 18) is denied to those who keep doing evil.
